title: Use of Digital Signature Certificates and Aadhar e-Sign
text: 1.05 Use of Digital Signature Certificates and Aadhar e-Sign DGFT allows submission of applications authenticated through digital signature certificate (DSC) issued by any approved entity of Controller of Certifying Authority of India or through Aadhar e Sign in online environment.
intent: Support Use of Digital Signature Certificates and Aadhar e-Sign processing and compliance validation.
tags: Use of Digital Signature Certificates and Aadhar e-Sign
